summary.en: China warned it could cut undersea cables linking Taiwan and the Philippines while increasing patrols near Taiwan, raising maritime tension. The Philippine Coast Guard investigated a Chinese survey ship carrying unidentified equipment inside Scarborough Shoal and deployed its flagship BRP Teresa Magbanua to southeastern Mindanao to intensify patrols and deter illegal activities. The Coast Guard also rescued a ferry in Quezon waters, delivered fuel to fishermen at Scarborough Shoal, and assisted over 150,000 sea travelers during the Undas period. The conflict remains low-intensity, with 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kina advarte om at de kunne kutte undersjøiske kabler som knytter Taiwan og Filippinene, samtidig som de øker patruljene nær Taiwan, noe som øker spenningen til sjøs. Filippinenes kystvakt undersøkte et kinesisk undersøkelsesskip som fraktet ukjent utstyr inn i Scarborough-revet og sendte sitt flaggskip BRP Teresa Magbanua til sørøstlige Mindanao for å intensivere patruljene og avskrekke ulovlige aktiviteter. Kystvakten reddet også en ferge i farvannet utenfor Quezon, leverte drivstoff til fiskere ved Scarborough-revet, og bistod over 150 000 sjøreisende i Undas-perioden. Konflikten forblir lavintensiv, med 176 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
